data.name: Adventure Master
data.detailed_description:
This unique trivia game is the perfect way to be tested to see if you could actually follow in the steps of the famous adventurers, Indiana Jones and Nathan Drake! Developed by a professional treasure hunt designer with hunts facilitated all over the world, this trivia game will test your knowledge on everything from outdoor survival skills and basic handguns to geography and world history to even how to SCUBA and basic plane flight and so much more.

You find yourself stumbling across the Quest Adventure Society, an underground society responsible for creating adventure across the globe, and desire desperately to become a member of the team. They don’t accept new members so readily, though. You’re tasked with finding 50 treasures hidden all over the world. You’ll go from location to location in a treasure hunt fashion to find each treasure and only way to continue on your adventure will be to correctly answer trivia questions on a variety of topics that Jones and Drake would likely know. With numerous randomizers utilized, there are literally trillions of possible combinations of locations and trivia questions possible to find each treasure.

Additionally, sometimes when you answer a question correctly you’ll be given an opportunity to answer a BONUS question based on classic adventure stories in the movies and literature for additional experience points in various categories.

Your progress is also tracked with a variety of possible XP categories from specialties in specific continents to proficiencies in vehicle handling and negotiating jungle terrain. Over 20 different categories are tracked.

No matter what your knowledge base currently is, find all 50 treasures in this game and you’ll be primed by the end to travel the globe in search of your own real world adventures.

This game plays in your Internet browser and with nearly 1500 adventure trivia questions being asked, you’ve likely never been tested like this before...
